**How the examples are chosen**

The in-context examples are, to a first approximation, selected randomly from the scenario's training set, while ensuring coverage of different classes for classification problems — concretely, examples are sampled in order of class frequency so that the 5 most frequent classes are represented in-context [helm-p056-t2] [helm-p046-t2]. No. The same examples are used across all evaluation instances rather than selecting different in-context examples for each instance: "Critically, we choose to fix the in-context examples across all evaluation instances, in contrast to prior work (e.g. Brown et al., 2020), to more accurately perform few-shot evaluation" [helm-p046-t2].
